issues.description: Method name mismatch for the arbitrary-size QFT API: the template defines a method named _qft_circuit_n_qubits(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) (leading underscore) while the solution and the exercise/test naming use qft_circuit_n_qubits(self, qc: QuantumCircuit) (no underscore). Because the problem statement and tests expect the public API qft_circuit_n_qubits for Exercise 7, the underscored name in the template will confuse students and may cause tests or autograding to fail when code is imported or invoked under the expected name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the QFT method name consistent across template, solution, and tests. Prefer the public name without a leading underscore: rename def _qft_circuit_n_qubits(...) in template/ex2_qft.py to def qft_circuit_n_qubits(...). Ensure any references/tests call qft_circuit_n_qubits. Alternatively, if the design intentionally intended a private helper, update the solution and tests to call the underscored name consistently — but keeping the public name qft_circuit_n_qubits is recommended for clarity.
